metadata.sourceEncoding: Google encoded polyline with 1e6 coordinate scale decoded per official IFIMap.js
metadata.polygonRepresentation: MultiPolygon; each original school.Polygons array element is a polygon and serialized inner rings are preserved as holes
metadata.academicYearEvidence: Infofinder redistrict group names explicitly 2026-2027; linked from Prosper ISD official Attendance Boundaries page
metadata.info: The official geometry is a current-year zone reference, not a guarantee of enrollment eligibility at a specific home or apartment. Check district lookup for exact address, program and exceptions.
